direction_definition: Per-column face normal from the nearest NHSKIN source face in the 15-column probe, computed on current037 Wnew-deformed detail vertices; face winding is BFS-oriented and absolute component sign is anchored by the same source O-to-I layer-order rule in orientation audit 112. The identical per-column normal is used for O and I starts.
limitations: O-D direction is a construction field, not anatomical outward proof.
Planes are per complete bank, not whole-surface/tet clearance or native/physical admission.
Overlapping constraints across banks remain separate.

scope: First outward exit for every O- or I-inside relation among the 15 selected columns, against each implicated complete typed bank.
